name: Editable Visual Deck
description: An offline-ready HTML presentation with a dark modular-grid look, sharp action headlines, and editable charts and diagrams. Built for product launches and executive updates that need both polish and fast revision.
whatYouGet: Editable text, charts, diagrams, and visual blocks
A consistent grid, color system, and slide hierarchy
goodFit: A product launch narrative for internal or client stakeholders
An executive update that turns evidence into decisions
A presentation that will undergo several content revisions
notFor: Recreating an existing deck pixel for pixel
Delivering only a native presentation file
requiredInputs: Required sections or target slide count

faq.q: Can I edit the charts after delivery?
faq.a: Yes. Chart labels, values, and shapes are built as editable HTML, CSS, or SVG elements rather than a single slide image.

faq.q: What happens if my notes lack numbers?
faq.a: The deck can use qualitative comparisons and process visuals. It will not present invented metrics as facts.

faq.q: Can the deck work without an internet connection?
faq.a: Yes. The deliverable uses system fonts and is designed to be self-contained.

demoPrompt: /sl-editable-visual-deck Create exactly 9 slides for Workspace Hub, a fictional Sample Software Studio product, helping department leads decide on a pilot. Cover the coordination problem, product approach and capabilities, illustrative adoption, pilot plan, and approval. Title: “One workspace can make team decisions easier to find.” Close: “Approve the pilot to validate the launch case.” Use editable Signal Blocks visuals.
followUpPrompts: Replace the illustrative adoption model with these approved pilot figures and update the chart takeaway.
Adapt this deck for a five-minute executive presentation without changing its visual system.
Add speaker notes that explain the evidence behind each slide's claim.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
